summary: Iteration 122 SuperAdmin batch 2 — 9-point overhaul verified end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 pytest passed (test_iteration122_superadmin_batch2.py) covering reset-password auto-generation (no plaintext leak in response, email_sent flag returned), delete-admin OTP request+wrong-code confirm, renewals active_trials bucket (Kritika bug fixed — trial with sub_months=0 now lands in active_trials[], not expired[], and stats.active_trials_count is exposed), staff GET returns departments list (Support/Sales/Finance/Onboarding/Product/Engineering/Operations), staff POST accepts department+mobile+features and persists them on the flowra_staff doc with email_sent flag, prospect PUT status='demo_given' with demo_given_at='2026-02-20' stamps both demo_given_at and demo_completed=true, and employee login inherits admin's features array (busydemo tenant — employee login returns non-empty features matching admin's list, fixing the 'all features disabled' P0). Frontend E2E on preview URL: super-admin-dashboard renders 13 tabs, Subscriptions summary cards (Total/Active/Trial/Expiring/Expired) are clickable and filter the table (13->10 rows on Trial, toggle back to 13), reminder-preview-modal still works from the envelope icon, Invoices paid/unpaid cards clickable, Renewals renders 5 cards including renewal-card-trials with 10 trial-row entries when clicked, Prospects has new/contacted/converted/lost cards clickable, Admin Mgmt shows 13 reset-pwd + 13 delete-admin action buttons (data-testid present, buttons wrap on mobile per code review), Staff modal has staff-department-select + staff-mobile-input inputs, delete-otp-modal opens on Trash click with confirm() dialog accepted, wrong OTP '000000' returns 'Incorrect code. Try again.' toast and keeps modal open.

issues: Interactive browser login with superadmin/superadmin123 was rejected on preview with 'CAPTCHA verification failed.' The reCAPTCHA v3 token returned by Google for the preview hostname triggers a hard failure code that is NOT in the fail-open env_errors set in services/recaptcha.py. Direct API calls with empty captcha_token still fail-open (backend suite works). Consider adding 'invalid-keys' / 'bad-request' / 'invalid-site-secret-key' to the env_errors bypass set, OR whitelisting the preview hostname 'tally-report-ai.preview.emergentagent.com' in the reCAPTCHA console, OR toggling the site key to the test key 6LeIPAcTAAAAAMy... in preview so all E2E logins work through the UI. Testing worked by injecting flowra_token via localStorage after a direct /api/auth/login call.

Same enrichment-loop slowness flagged in iter-121 persists — /api/super-admin/admins takes 10-20 s before super-admin-dashboard testid appears (had to bump wait_for_selector to 60 s). Batch the resolve_company_names + count_documents + payments.find per admin.

action_items: MEDIUM (login UX): Fix reCAPTCHA v3 on the preview hostname so interactive Sign In works — either add hard-failure codes for missing site-key to the env_errors bypass, whitelist the preview domain in reCAPTCHA console, or use the Google test key in preview. Currently only direct-API login works; the UI login is broken end-to-end on preview.
MINOR (perf, carried over from iter-121): Speed up /api/super-admin/admins first paint (N+1 enrichment loop) — SuperAdmin dashboard takes ~15 s to appear.
critical_code_review_comments: super_admin.py request_delete_admin_otp/confirm-delete-otp: OTP is stored plaintext in db.admin_delete_otps. Consider hashing (sha256) before storing and comparing hashes on confirm — otherwise a DB read exposes valid OTPs. Also add a MongoDB TTL index on expires_at to auto-purge expired records.

super_admin.py reset_admin_password: no rate-limiting. A compromised SA session could rotate every admin password in a loop. Consider a per-target cooldown (e.g. 1 reset / 5 min) and email the ORIGINAL admin's alternate contact / phone as well when configured.

super_admin.py create_staff: password is echoed back inside the welcome email HTML (line 195) — that's fine for the intended recipient but bear in mind Resend logs will contain the plaintext. If email delivery moves to a shared mailbox, consider a one-time-set-password link instead.

auth.py login (features inheritance): the employee feature-inheritance fallback runs an extra db.users.find_one on every employee login. For a hot login endpoint, cache the admin's features on the employee doc at CREATE time (already sort-of possible via the /auth/users flow) or memoise per tenant to avoid the extra round-trip.

prospects.py update_prospect_status: demo_given_at is stored verbatim as a string with no format validation. A malformed input like 'not-a-date' would pass silently. Add ISO-8601 validation before writing to keep downstream reports safe.

SuperAdminDashboard.js deleteAdmin flow: uses window.confirm() which cannot be styled, dismissed by Escape without visual feedback, or interacted with by screen readers well. A stylised confirm dialog would be more consistent with the OTP modal that follows.

ProspectsTab.jsx: the inline prospect-status select only renders inside the drill-down (expanded card). Playwright therefore cannot exercise the demo_given → demo-date-modal transition without first clicking to expand — worth exposing an unconditional status selector or a top-level 'Change Status' testid to make the flow more discoverable.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all 9 SuperAdmin flows verified; the only friction was reCAPTCHA rejection on browser login, worked around by direct-API auth)

Frontend browser login currently fails on preview because of reCAPTCHA v3 rejection — bypass by fetching /api/auth/login directly (captcha_token: '' fails-open server-side) and injecting the returned token into localStorage.setItem('flowra_token', token) then page.reload(). rca of the issue: Kritika 'trial expired' bug (P0): admin doc has is_trial=true, subscription_months=0, trial_end in the future. Old renewals endpoint fell into the days_left branch with sub_months=0 → days_left computed as -(days since sub_start) which was negative → landed in expired[]. Fix (super_admin.py line 1229): trial admins now short-circuit on is_trial and are bucketed by trial_end instead — negative days_left goes to expired, non-negative goes to a new active_trials[] bucket + stats.active_trials_count. Verified via TestRenewals which creates a fresh trial admin (plan='trial') and asserts it lands in active_trials, not expired. Employee 'all features disabled' bug (P0): login response was hard-coding features=user.get('features',[]) which for role=employee is always empty because employees don't own features. Fix (auth.py line 200): employees now inherit their admin's features via a lookup on {tenant_id, role:'admin'}. Verified via TestEmployeeFeatureInheritance which creates an employee under busydemo and asserts the login response's features array is non-empty and equals the admin's set.
